description: Owned four-way indexed heap repairs and a callback-backed binary heap interface.
status: Complete capability mapping, both frontend runtime/reference/ownership gates, parent Cargo targets, full self-built Native family and documented source distribution passed. Full standard-library goal remains open.

capability_mapping.Interface/Len/Less/Swap/Push/Pop: Opaque HeapView carries coherent caller-owned length/comparison/swap/append/remove-last callbacks, including mutable index bookkeeping. Callback contracts and consistent strict ordering are documented.
capability_mapping.Init: heap-view-init over caller-owned data; heap-init/heap-init-by and existing Floyd list construction over dense owned storage.
capability_mapping.Push/Pop: heap-view-push/pop plus existing heap-push/pop and custom-order variants; empty removals return None.
capability_mapping.Remove: heap-view-remove with checked index; heap-remove/heap-remove-by provide four-way owned repairs.
capability_mapping.Fix: heap-view-fix after caller mutation; heap-fix/heap-fix-by after externally changed priorities, plus atomic checked heap-replace variants.

observations: owned indexed replace/remove and mutable priority fix
tests.note: The separate Rust control check type-checks every helper. The Native corpus uses a corrected Cinch compiler compiled by frozen Rust; the source fixture now observes local list emptiness directly to avoid a missing generic O variant in the older provider. Library bytes match all receipts.

implementation_notes: Owned heap index arithmetic and sift paths retain private U64 slot workers and bulk ownership-moving growth.
Arbitrary comparison/swap callbacks have visible ordering and cannot be reassociated or SIMD-batched. Pointer-dependent sift traversal is serial.
HeapView currently incurs indirect callback, checked vector, ownership and Nat arithmetic paths; no throughput or allocation parity is claimed.
Full constructor-tree fixture initialization overflowed the frozen Rust compiler stack at257items; independently packed input now materializes as runtime records. No library algorithm was weakened.
native_initial_blockers: Existing phantom region parameters in Vec/Var/Heap default to Type when Native only examines constructor fields. Source Region annotations are not supported by the frozen Rust nominal-kind converter.
Native currently generalizes effectful strict bindings, separating a newly allocated container's region from its performed Mut row.

The Core kind table admits Mut as ownership Region->Type->Type but ordinary name lookup rejects Mut effect labels Region->Effect; focused contextual repair8aff20d0 is held until mutable value restriction is corrected.
pending: Full self-built Native compiler fixed point with the focused mutation-kind and strict value-restriction repairs.
Parent Cargo targets: lib_heap_view, bootstrap_mutation_kinds, bootstrap_mutable_inference and preserved typing/effect gates.
